title: Coin change from a limited supply with seeded tie-breaks
notes: S1-E-PY. EvoEval-style mutation: d3 limited supply (dict of available counts), a seeded tie-break among the fewest-coin answers (prefer larger or smaller coins) and a seeded output order; d4 + fewest different coin values as the first tie-break; d5 + a seeded pair of coin values that may not be used together.
